X.note: The best-instrumented page, with live progress, peak overshoot and settle stats, but all three curves are near-identical fast ease-outs with about 1% overshoot, and each loop snaps back to start after the hold instead of returning.

Y.note: The cards are clear and well labeled, but the three curves are almost the same ease-out with 0 to 1.2% overshoot, so sticky-settle and punchy-sticky barely differ, and the loops jump back instead of returning.

Z.note: The curve set is the most distinct and punchy of the four (0%, 5.3% overshoot, and a grip S-curve), and the loops return seamlessly, but there is no graph, no measured values and no hold, so the curves are barely explained.
